result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: an implausible '-100%' discount badge on the pizza card. Other partially visible horizontal and bottom content is intentional scroll behavior.

issues.description: The discount badge on the partially visible pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' reads '-100%', which implies the item is free / a nonsensical 100% price reduction and looks like a broken or incorrectly formatted promotion value.
issues.suggestion: Verify the promotion data for this restaurant and format the badge correctly, e.g. show the intended percentage like '-10%' or explicit wording like '100% off' / 'Free', and add validation to prevent displaying '-100%'.
